decision: D-006: P3-U1a rewrites task release:local-update to pull, install, confirm the installed version equals the pin. (a) The refusal to start on uncommitted changes is dropped (git pull --ff-only already refuses to overwrite local changes; refreshed hook files are normal under Rule 1). (b) The release-age check on pnpm-workspace.yaml is removed (pnpm reports age problems itself). Release tooling only; no OVPR text change.
